discordGroups is the server's channel list, by category, so somebody can see what they are joining before they join.
discordRules is a summary of the rules as posted in #rules. Both came from the planning session, which built the

discordGroups.name: Information
discordGroups.what: What the project is, what is being worked on, and the rules of the server. Read only, so it stays readable.

discordGroups.name: Using GroupLab
discordGroups.what: Questions about the application: printing a sheet, reading a scan, a number that looks wrong, a build that will not start.

discordGroups.name: Shooting
discordGroups.what: Targets, groups, loads and what people are shooting. Not about the software.

discordGroups.name: Development
discordGroups.what: How GroupLab is built and why, what is being measured, and what is coming next.

discordGroups.name: Voice
discordGroups.what: Talking rather than typing, for anybody who would rather explain something out loud.

discordRules: Be civil. Disagree with the idea, not the person.
Use the channel that fits the subject. Long side discussions belong in a thread.
No firearm, ammunition or component sales, trades or transfers.
No load data handed out as safe to copy. Say what you observed, and let people work up their own loads from published data.
No advertising or self promotion without asking a moderator first.
Safety is not a joke. Muzzle discipline and range rules get discussed seriously.
Post only images that belong to you. Anything posted there can be seen by anyone.
No personal information about yourself or anyone else, including addresses and anything that identifies where someone shoots.
English in the public channels, so moderation can keep up.
Moderator decisions stand in the moment. Appeals go to a direct message.
